import copy, hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/workspace/scratch/bfccb8494ba0')
OUT=ROOT/'round27-oracle-compatibility-independent'
OLD=ROOT/'round27-integration-P-source-review'
SRC=ROOT/'round27-oracle-dual-spool-compatibility-candidate'
P='44c3fa6d8d69c6e51c1c3eb717cbfd23dc80a1ec'
PARENT='411336a666df78cfc96172b889f9109c3e84c295'
TREE='0776207a487d8e027ef772b283b9e53c9fabf26f'
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def oid(kind,b): return hashlib.sha1(kind.encode()+b' '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
def toid(rows):
    body=b''.join(r['mode'].lstrip('0').encode()+b' '+r['path'].encode()+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(r['sha']) for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r['path'].encode()+(b'/' if r['type']=='tree' else b'')))
    return oid('tree',body)
oldbytes=(OLD/'independent-source-review.json').read_bytes()
assert sha(oldbytes)=='054c7a37e2403375f234f74864a78abeea059e64845ac36953248b2c37b5856a'
assert oid('blob',oldbytes)=='4a6bd606e49c6e0a2bfcd49409a1f4b71d6cefc9'
prior=json.loads(oldbytes)
commit=read(OUT/'official/actual-P-commit.json')
compare=read(OUT/'official/actual-P-versus-parent-compare.json')
assert commit['sha']==P and commit['tree']['sha']==TREE
assert [r['sha'] for r in commit['parents']]==[PARENT]
assert compare['base_commit']['sha']==PARENT
assert len(compare['commits'])==1 and compare['commits'][0]['sha']==P
root=read(OLD/'official/actual-P-root-tree.json')
assert root['sha']==prior['source_tree'] and not root['truncated'] and toid(root['tree'])==root['sha']
groups={'':copy.deepcopy(root['tree'])}; expected={'':root['sha']}
for prefix,name in [('.github','github'),('crates','crates'),('scripts','scripts'),('tests','tests')]:
    d=read(OLD/f'official/actual-P-{name}-tree.json')
    assert not d['truncated'] and d['sha']==next(r['sha'] for r in root['tree'] if r['path']==prefix)
    groups[prefix]=[]; expected[prefix]=d['sha']
    for row in d['tree']:
        parent,_,base=row['path'].rpartition('/')
        path=prefix+('/'+parent if parent else '')
        groups.setdefault(path,[]).append(dict(row,path=base))
        if row['type']=='tree':
            expected[prefix+'/'+row['path']]=row['sha']
            groups.setdefault(prefix+'/'+row['path'],[])
assert set(groups)==set(expected)
for path,entries in groups.items(): assert toid(entries)==expected[path],path
manifest=read(SRC/'source-manifest.json')
files={r['path']:r for r in manifest['files']}
assert len(files)==2 and {r['filename'] for r in compare['files']}==set(files)
assert all(r['status']=='modified' for r in compare['files'])
complete=copy.deepcopy(prior['complete_inputs']); delta=copy.deepcopy(prior['paths']); inv=copy.deepcopy(prior['actual_input_mode_blob_inventory'])
proof=[]
for path,f in files.items():
    before=(SRC/'original'/path).read_bytes(); after=(SRC/'candidate'/path).read_bytes()
    for raw,part in [(before,'original'),(after,'candidate')]:
        assert len(raw)==f[part]['bytes'] and sha(raw)==f[part]['sha256'] and oid('blob',raw)==f[part]['git_blob']
    assert inv[path]['sha']==f['original']['git_blob'] and inv[path]['sha256']==sha(before)
    assert next(r['sha'] for r in compare['files'] if r['filename']==path)==oid('blob',after)
    par,_,base=path.rpartition('/')
    row=next(r for r in groups[par] if r['path']==base)
    assert row['mode']=='100644' and row['type']=='blob' and row['sha']==oid('blob',before)
    row.update(sha=oid('blob',after),size=len(after))
    complete[path]=sha(after); delta[path]['sha256']=sha(after)
    assert set(delta[path])=={'before_sha256','sha256'} and delta[path]['before_sha256']!=sha(after)
    inv[path]={'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':oid('blob',after),'size':len(after),'sha256':sha(after)}
    proof.append({'path':path,'before':prior['actual_input_mode_blob_inventory'][path],'after':inv[path],'BASE_before_sha256':delta[path]['before_sha256']})
changed_trees=[]
for path in sorted(groups,key=lambda p:p.count('/')+bool(p),reverse=True):
    new=toid(groups[path])
    if new!=expected[path]: changed_trees.append({'path':path,'before':expected[path],'after':new})
    if path:
        parent,_,base=path.rpartition('/')
        next(r for r in groups[parent] if r['path']==base)['sha']=new
assert toid(groups[''])==TREE
actual={}
for parent,entries in groups.items():
    for r in entries:
        if r['type']=='blob': actual[(parent+'/' if parent else '')+r['path']]=r
assert len(complete)==1096 and len(delta)==78 and len(prior['validation_inputs'])==146 and len(inv)==1242
for path,row in inv.items():
    assert {k:row[k] for k in ('mode','type','sha','size')}=={k:actual[path][k] for k in ('mode','type','sha','size')},path
    assert row['sha256']==(complete|prior['validation_inputs'])[path]
assert {p for p in complete if complete[p]!=prior['complete_inputs'][p]}==set(files)
assert all(delta[p]['before_sha256']==prior['paths'][p]['before_sha256'] for p in delta)
assert all(delta[p]['sha256']==complete[p] for p in delta)
prod='crates/cc-eval/src/benchmark/oracle/streaming.rs'; test='crates/cc-eval/tests/benchmark_oracle_streaming.rs'
before=(SRC/'original'/prod).read_text(); after=(SRC/'candidate'/prod).read_text(); legacy=(SRC/'legacy-C3ff-streaming.rs').read_text()
def body(text,name):
    start=text.index('fn '+name+'('); end=text.index('\n#[cfg(test)]',start)
    return text[start:end]
assert body(after,'compare_with_validated_limits')==body(legacy,'compare_with_validated_limits')
assert before[before.index('#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {'):]==after[after.index('#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {'):]
assert before[:before.index('\nfn stored_table(')]==after[:after.index('\nfn next_row(')]
assert before[before.index('\nfn next_row('):before.index('\nfn compare_with_validated_limits(')]==after[after.index('\nfn next_row('):after.index('\nfn compare_with_validated_limits(')]
assert all(x not in after for x in ('equal_input_order','identical_cells','stored_table'))
bt=(SRC/'original'/test).read_text(); at=(SRC/'candidate'/test).read_text()
names=lambda s:re.findall(r'#\[test\]\s*fn\s+(\w+)',s)
assert len(names(bt))==11 and len(names(at))==13
assert set(names(at))-set(names(bt))=={'equal_inputs_must_both_fit_the_original_scratch_limit','public_table_json_retains_the_original_field_set','distinct_sql_types_and_column_layouts_keep_the_original_results','second_input_budgets_and_first_error_remain_enforced'}
result={'schema_version':1,'verdict':'accepted_static_source_and_exact_actual_P_domain','actual_P':P,'tree':TREE,'sole_parent':PARENT,'counts':{'product':len(complete),'BASE_delta':len(delta),'validation':len(prior['validation_inputs']),'inventory':len(inv)},'all_parent_trees_recomputed':len(groups),'changed_tree_nodes':changed_trees,'changed_source_byte_proof':proof,'complete_inputs':complete,'paths':delta,'validation_inputs':prior['validation_inputs'],'actual_input_mode_blob_inventory':inv,'semantic_mechanical_checks':{'compare_body_exact_pre_witness_C3ff':True,'old_private_unit_module_byte_identical':True,'all_batching_projection_spool_helpers_byte_identical_to_parent':True,'resource_limits_sorted_cursor_digest_helpers_byte_identical':True,'witness_functions_and_public_key_removed':True,'integration_tests_before':11,'integration_tests_after':13},'execution_boundary':'Read-only metadata/hash/static-source review only. No Rust, fmt, Clippy, SQLite experiment, source-v15 or performance test executed.'}
(OUT/'actual-P-complete-domain-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('verdict','actual_P','tree','counts','all_parent_trees_recomputed','semantic_mechanical_checks')}))
